Get Basketligaen Standings

Source: R/sportality.R
sportality_standings.Rd

Standings of an ssgt (gameday widget).

Endpoint: GET https://www.basketligaen.dk/api/gameday/team-standings/{ssgt_uuid}

Usage

sportality_standings(ssgt_uuid)

Arguments

ssgt_uuid

(required) ssgt uuid: one season + series + game type, e.g. xs07bd3fmp = 2026/2027 regular season. Directory: /statistics-v2/layout-info seasonSeriesGameTypeTeams[].ssgtUuid.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Standings of an ssgt (gameday widget). An empty valid answer raises hoopR_no_data; the documented columns come first, in this order (sportsdataverse-py sportality_standings), then any column the API added later:

col_nametypedescription
team_idintegerGenius team id (Int64): in gameday bodies, an integer in standings and stats tables.
team_uuidcharacterPlatform team uuid.
team_codecharacterPlatform team code (HOL, RAN).
team_namecharacterName of the team.
rankintegerRank in the standings table, 1 = first.
gpintegerNumber of games played.
wintegerNumber of wins.
lintegerNumber of losses.
tpintegerLeague table points (2 per win).
forintegerPoints scored by the team (points for).
gaintegerPoints conceded.
plus_minusintegerPoint difference.
strkintegerCurrent streak as a signed integer: positive = wins in a row, negative = losses in a row.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in sportality_schedule().

See also

Other Basketligaen Functions: sportality_athlete_career(), sportality_athlete_details(), sportality_athlete_profile(), sportality_boxscore(), sportality_game_header(), sportality_game_overview(), sportality_game_summary(), sportality_last_game_day(), sportality_layout_info(), sportality_next_game_day(), sportality_pbp(), sportality_player_box(), sportality_player_crosswalk(), sportality_player_h2h(), sportality_post_game_team_stats(), sportality_roster(), sportality_schedule(), sportality_season_filter(), sportality_sites(), sportality_ssgt_provider(), sportality_ssgt_uuid(), sportality_stats_info(), sportality_team(), sportality_team_played_games(), sportality_team_stats(), sportality_team_upcoming_games()
